_readme: S671 SkyKinglet, 2026-11-17. The RCCD pilot (#3237 start brief 6935299361, step 4) and #3430: the district's local associate-degree general education page, shared by Riverside City, Norco and Moreno Valley, read for its areas, each area's units and the courses it lists; #3430 asks which of KIN A81A, KIN A81B and HES 1 the page places in Area 7 (Lifelong Learning and Self-Development), from the page and never from the brief. Also the Military Credit page the district profile cites (kb/district_profiles/riverside.json), for its policy number and notation. Free: no model call. Read after the Riverside City harvest read, never beside it (one host).

questions.local_ge_areas: The RCCD general education pattern's areas, each area's name and required units, and the total.
questions.area7_courses: Which courses the page lists under Area 7 (Lifelong Learning and Self-Development); whether KIN A81A, KIN A81B and HES 1 are among them.
questions.military_credit: The Military Credit page's policy number (BP/AP), what it awards for basic training, and how the credit is noted or graded.
